evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Directive issued in the present addresses a concrete named fleet and its contracts; 'forget' suspends realis by commanding erasure of actual knowledge.

observations.why: Present-tense imperative targeting concrete artifacts (zeppelin routes); 'remove' commands erasure of actual knowledge, suspending realis.
